changes: purpose cleared: 'śubham astu jagataḥ' is a general benediction, not a statement of purpose
notes expanded: the length of the lacuna is unknown, so 'Abhayānanda' is only a conjecture; no date or place given

notes: The start of the scribe's name is lost or illegible ('(‥)bhayānanda'). Abhayānanda is the most likely reading, but the lacuna may hold more than one akṣara, so this is a guess. The colophon gives no date, place or commissioner. It closes the 'parārddha' (the Uttaratantra part, chapter 15) of the Guhyasamāja.
